topic: Why GoMining net results vary and can be low or negative
hook: A digital miner's results can be low or even negative. Here's why.

scenes.narration: Owners are credited daily bitcoin rewards, minus a maintenance charge for electricity and service costs.
Rewards and fees change with the bitcoin price, network difficulty and hashrate.
So net results vary and can be low or negative.
Treat every projection as an estimate, never a promise.

cta: Would this change how you look at it? Comment below. My referral link is in the description.
title: Why GoMining Results Vary (and Can Be Negative)
description_body: Rewards minus maintenance depend on price, difficulty and hashrate, so net results can be low or negative.
